messages:
lee: flagging alert from apac-proxy cluster after the config roll. lots of mTLS handshake failures, looks like client cert unwrap errors and SNI mismatches.

taylor: which key/role touched in the rollout? any RBAC changes in the PR?

lee: PR 4971 tightened KMS key access for several roles, reduced kms:Decrypt to only alias/rotator-apac. we see failed decrypts for role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/cert-fetcher. logs: 
```
2026-03-22T02:41:12Z proxy-apac-07 cert_fetch: found wrapped_client_key s3://certs-apac/wrapped/key-20260322
2026-03-22T02:41:12Z proxy-apac-07 kms_unwrap: DecryptDenied principal=arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/cert-fetcher key=alias/sessions/apac
2026-03-22T02:41:12Z proxy-apac-07 tls_handshake_fail: ERR_SSL_BAD_CLIENT_CERT
2026-03-22T02:41:12Z proxy-apac-07 sni=svc-billing.apac.internal expected_cn=svc-billing.apac.internal, cert_cn=svc-billing-old.apac.internal
```

nina: deploy-bot shows PR merged at 02:20. We also rotated client certs at 02:30 as part of the rollout. looks like ripple effect.

deploy-bot: Audit: CloudTrail shows 84 KMS:DecryptDenied events for principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/cert-fetcher between 02:40:00 and 02:42:30 in ap-southeast-1. Related PR: #4971 (rbac/kms-scoping).

lee: immediate plan: re-add allow for alias/sessions/apac to cert-fetcher role (scoped, 1h) and trigger a config reload for apac proxies. Also pause further cert rotations until stable.

taylor: added temp allow at 02:46, verifying.

deploy-bot: Verification: KMS:Decrypt succeeded for arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/cert-fetcher at 02:47:01.

nina: canary reload shows client cert unwrap success and session resume rate improving. full reload in progress.

lee: root cause summary for postmortem: RBAC change to KMS key alias scoping omitted a runtime consumer (cert-fetcher). This caused wrapped client keys to be unreadable -> client cert validation failures -> SNI mismatch logs as older certs were still cached.

taylor: follow-ups: 1) add infra test that simulates KMS Deny for each role that consumes keys (rotator, distributor, fetcher) before merging alias scoping changes; 2) add alert: KMS:DecryptDenied count > 0 for any role tagged cert-consumer in 3m -> page eng-security; 3) make client cert unwrap fallback to trigger full TLS handshake instead of dropping connection.

ops-oncall: compliance note: capture Git history and approval for RBAC change and attach to incident. update secure-deploy checklist to require a key-consumer inventory stamp before RBAC changes.

lee: also propose adding a small local cache for unwrapped client keys with a short TTL (2m) so proxies can survive transient KMS outages. need security review.

nina: I'll start the postmortem draft and include the CloudTrail query I used: 
```
EventName = "Decrypt" OR EventName = "Decrypt*" | where eventSource == "kms.amazonaws.com" and recipientAccountId == "111222333444" | where eventTime between ("2026-03-22T02:30:00Z","2026-03-22T03:00:00Z")
```

lee: assigning: @taylor add temp-policy rollback and PR with infra tests; @nina write postmortem & include CT snippets; @ops-oncall update secure-deploy checklist and create alert.

ops-oncall: will add alert and dashboard showing client_cert_fail_rate by region, and increase CloudTrail retention for this incident to 45 days. :clipboard: 

lee: thanks all. closing thread once postmortem is linked. :thumbsup:
